description: This file implements a StorageService class that manages file storage operations in Minio, including uploading logs and files, generating presigned URLs, and deleting objects. It is part of a backend service for a test script management system.

classes.name: StorageService
classes.description: Provides methods for managing files and logs in Minio object storage, including uploading, generating URLs, and deletion.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes Minio client and ensures required storage buckets exist.

methods.name: _ensure_buckets(self)
methods.description: Checks and creates necessary Minio buckets if they do not exist.

methods.name: str upload_log(self, run_id: str, content: str)
methods.description: Uploads a test execution log as a string content to Minio under logs folder.

methods.name: str upload_file(self, file: BinaryIO, filename: str, content_type: str = "application/octet-stream")
methods.description: Uploads a binary file object to Minio with specified filename and content type.

methods.name: str get_presigned_url(self, bucket: str, object_key: str, expires: int = 3600)
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for accessing an object, with optional expiration time.

methods.name: str get_log_url(self, object_key: str)
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL specifically for log files.

methods.name: delete_object(self, bucket: str, object_key: str)
methods.description: Deletes an object from a specified Minio bucket.

ctags.signature: (self, file: BinaryIO, filename: str, content_type: str = "application/octet-stream")

ctags.pattern: /^    def upload_log(self, run_id: str, content: str) -> str:$/
